notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The only sourced facts are the FFLA listing (standing, Beltrami County, coordinates, type Tower, no register number) and a Roaming Civic list entry dated 2025 with no description. Two WebSearch queries and the Beltrami and state FFLA lists turned up no build date, builder, height, owner, staffing or access statement. The anyplaceamerica.com tower page returned HTTP 403, so it was not read. A TopoQuest hit for Mud River Reservoir is a different place about 9 km away and is not used. Suggested next checks: Beltrami County Historical Society, Minnesota DNR forestry records, and FFLA's Minnesota chapter reports (the 2007 and 2019 reports fetched here do not mention Mud River).
